# `vox-actor-runtime`

**Crate:** `vox-actor-runtime` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Process-oriented runtime: actors, mailboxes, supervision, scheduling, LLM/Mens activity primitives.

## Crate Overview

Process-oriented runtime primitives for Vox: actors, mailboxes, supervision, and scheduling.

Submodules implement the durable / distributed process story; this crate root mostly re-exports
stable names for embedders. Detailed behavior is documented on the defining types inside each
module; blanket Rustdoc on every `pub use` alias would add noise without semantic value.

## Public API Surface

### Modules

| Module | Description |
|---|---|
| `semcov_wave28_tests` | Adversarial semantic-coverage tests (wave 28). |
| `activity` | Durable activity execution: retries, timeouts, and backoff around async work. |
| `auth` | Authentication helpers for generated Vox services: API key / bearer validation and retry-after parsing. |
| `builtins` | Host-callable builtins surfaced to generated code (hashing, small helpers). |
| `credential_broker` | Zero-trust capability-scoped credential broker for agents and MCP tools (`CLAVIS-05`). |
| `db` | Optional Codex / Turso database handle when the `database` feature is enabled. |
| `durable_scheduler` | Durable / cron scheduler primitives for `@scheduled` + `@durable` (GA-11). |
| `gc` | Garbage collection arena and !Send pointers for actor memory isolation. |
| `inference_env` | Hugging Face router, Hub listings, and Mens/Ollama capability probes. |
| `llm` | OpenAI-compatible chat/embed clients, registry entries, and usage metrics. |
| `llm_result` | Typed result wrapper for structured LLM activity returns (parse-safe). |
| `mailbox` | Actor mailboxes: envelopes, messages, requests, and process signals. |
| `mens` | Mens/Ollama HTTP client for generate, embed, classify, and RAG helpers. |
| `model_resolution` | SSOT chat routing: manual URL, Mens, HF dedicated/router, OpenRouter. |
| `notify` | Multi-channel notification dispatch (GA-14): Email / SMS / WebPush. |
| `pid` | Opaque process identifiers for actors and messaging. |
| `presence` | Cursor-presence channel for real-time multiplayer (GA-25). |
| `process` | Actor `ProcessContext`, `ProcessHandle`, and `spawn_process`. |
| `prompt_canonical` | Prompt normalization, conflict detection, and safety pass for LLM ingress. |
| `registry` | Global map of live actors by [`Pid`] and optional name. |
| `resilient_http` | Retry policy and HTTP client with fallback endpoints. |
| `retrieval` | RAG-style chunk retrieval, context budgets, and provenance records. |
| `route_capability_policy` | `VOX_ROUTE_*` capability policy snapshot (shared with orchestrator explain/MCP paths). |
| `routing_telemetry` | Shared routing decision telemetry for DB joins (bounded `reason_json`). |
| `scheduler` | Cooperative Tokio-backed scheduler registering spawned actors. |
| `state_machine` | Reactive state-machine instance helper consumed by emitted state-machine hooks (Phase G of the Svelte-mineable features plan). |
| `subscription` | Per-table reactive mutation notifications (broadcast channels for reactive queries). |
| `supervisor` | Supervision strategies and child restart loops for actor trees. |
